title: Meridian Observatory
detail: MERIDIAN  /  Deep-space interferometer · Geometry study from the port-bow concept image. Metres; +X aft, +Y up, +Z port. · Start arguments: overall scale, half the telescope baseline in m, drum period in s. · The default is 900 m long with a 150 m baseline. Positive period required. · Try 65 to 85 m for the half-baseline. Try 120 for a slower habitat rotation. · For a spacecraft-only view use Start as printed. For the staged view replace · the Start line with: Start -> [ Meridian(1 75 60) ] [ RingedGiant ] · Preview camera in native metres, 35 mm lens on a 36 mm horizontal sensor. · Eye (-625.727 61.995 472.767), forward (0.74322 -0.07731 -0.66456), +Y up. · Lens shift (horizontal sensor-width units): -0.12503 -0.00547.
